name: My Demonically Lovelly Valentine!
source:
A lonely heart desires a date for Valentine's day, what better way to get it? By using dark art and summoning her of course! Nothing ever goes wrong that way!

Plus there's love in the air so maybe something will bloom out of it in the end.

[From [url=https://donutworks.itch.io/my-demonically-lovelly-valentine]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
一颗孤独的心渴望在情人节有个约会，还有什么更好的方法呢？当然是使用黑魔法并召唤她！这样就不会出错！

再加上空气中弥漫着爱的气息，所以也许最终会绽放出一些东西。

[来自[url=https://donutworks.itch.io/my-demonically-lovelly-valentine]Itch.io[/url]]
